# Junk My Car Red Deer

> Licensed vehicle buyer serving Red Deer, Red Deer County, and Central Alberta. We buy running, junk, scrap, damaged, written-off, farm, fleet, and long-sitting vehicles. Every accepted offer includes free towing, paperwork at pickup, and same-day cash or e-transfer.

Canonical site: https://www.junkmycarreddeer.ca/
Phone: +1-403-427-0732
Address: 4909 48 Street, Red Deer, Alberta T4N 1S8, Canada
